note: Living map of the AI-gateway / model-routing layer. Facts labeled; funding and deal figures are enriched from sourced research and marked when unverified.

segments.label: Independent gateways & routers
segments.blurb: Startups whose whole product is the routing/observability/spend layer between apps and models.

gateways.name: OpenRouter
gateways.does: Model marketplace + unified API over 400+ models; routing, fallback, spend

gateways.name: LiteLLM
gateways.does: Open-source unified API/proxy across 100+ providers; self-host or managed

gateways.name: Portkey
gateways.does: AI gateway + observability, guardrails, caching, fallback

gateways.name: Kong AI Gateway
gateways.does: API gateway extended for LLM traffic (routing, rate-limit, governance)

gateways.name: Martian
gateways.does: Model router — picks the cheapest capable model per request

gateways.name: Sapiom
gateways.does: Agent cost-routing to cheapest capable model (covered in Proof of Stack)

segments.label: Platform-owned gateways
segments.blurb: Dev-platforms and data clouds bundling a gateway to keep builders inside their ecosystem.

gateways.name: Vercel AI Gateway
gateways.does: Unified model access inside the Vercel/AI-SDK stack; fallback, observability

gateways.name: Databricks (Mosaic AI Gateway)
gateways.does: Model serving + gateway inside the data platform

gateways.name: Bedrock / Azure AI / Vertex
gateways.does: Hyperscaler model access layers with routing/guardrails

segments.label: Edge / CDN players
segments.blurb: The CDN incumbents moving up-stack — inference at the edge, gateways at the network layer.

gateways.name: Cloudflare AI Gateway
gateways.does: Gateway with caching, analytics, rate-limiting; pairs with Workers AI

gateways.name: Akamai
gateways.does: Edge/inference moves into AI delivery (see research)

segments.label: Payments / fintech-owned
segments.blurb: The surprise entrants — payments and spend-management platforms owning the metering layer.

gateways.name: Stripe (via OpenRouter)
gateways.does: Model gateway folded into a payments giant — metering + billing for AI

gateways.name: Ramp
gateways.does: Reported to have launched its own AI gateway (spend-management angle)

investors.note: led Wabi; active across agent infra
